post.summary:
Validates and creates a "mass delivery" child shipment split off from an unplanned
parent shipment: generates a new shipment number for the child (and for the parent, if
this is its first delivery), reduces the parent's delivered unit count by the requested
amount, and queues a background event for downstream notification/processing.
Adds a new comment to a shipment, stamped with the current user as author.

Removes a saved dashboard filter preset (by `FilterId`) from the current user's
settings. No-op if the user has no saved filters.
Deletes a shipment comment.

Validates then queues generation of a ZIP archive containing the PDFs of every sibling
shipment (split/mass-delivery children sharing the same parent) of the given shipment.
The queue consumer reuses already-generated PDFs where available, generates missing ones,
builds the zip, and pushes a completion notification with the zip file id and any failures.

Queues an asynchronous Excel export of shipments for a Deliveries-screen tab
(Incoming/Unplanned/Planned/Commissioned/Completed), scoped to the site and, for vendor
users, to their assigned teams. The queue consumer generates the workbook and pushes a
completion notification carrying the resulting `FileId`.

Fetches or generates a shipment's PDF. If a PDF already exists for the shipment/language
it's returned immediately; otherwise PDF generation is queued asynchronously and only the
(not-yet-ready) `PdfId` is returned so the client can poll/subscribe for completion.

Validates (shipment must exist and currently be `Planned`) then puts a planned
shipment on hold: clears its scheduled date and reverts it to `Unplanned`.

Creates or updates a dashboard filter preset on the current user's settings (bootstraps
the user's settings document if it doesn't exist yet). Matched by `FilterId`:
existing entries have their team/equipment filters updated; new ones are appended.

Notifies a shipment's responsible persons that its delivery date changed. Builds and
queues one email per supported language (purpose `KonsHubDeliveryDateUpdated`); the
queue consumer filters recipients by preferred language and active status before sending.

Sends a "shipment awaiting approval" notification email for an unapproved shipment.
Looks up the shipment (must currently be `UnApproved`) and queues one email per
supported language; does nothing if the shipment isn't found or isn't unapproved.

Splits a shipment into multiple shipments: updates the original (regenerating its
shipment number if not already split) and creates the new split-off shipments (each with
its own generated number). Queues background PDF-info regeneration and event logging for
both the original and the new shipments.

Queues the central "shipment event processed" pipeline for a shipment: refreshes
permissions, logs the event, regenerates the barcode, and triggers follow-up side
effects based on `EventType` — arrival events queue PDF+arrival email, delivered
events clear cached PDFs and queue PDF+completion email, schedule/update events on
today-or-later shipments re-queue PDF regeneration, and planned-update events with no
schedule date revert the shipment to `Unplanned`.
Overwrites the text of an existing shipment comment.

Validates then transitions a shipment's status from the Deliveries screen to
`Completed`, `Unplanned`, or `Arrived`, each with its own side effects:
`Completed` marks it done (with a "not arrived" flag if applicable) and queues a
completion notification; `Unplanned` reverts it to unplanned, records returned
units, and cancels any commissioning; `Arrived` records arrival details (photos,
delivery slips, storage zone/row/pitch, stacking) and moves it to Planned/Unplanned. All
branches log an event and re-queue PDF/email regeneration as needed.

Generates an Excel export of the filtered incoming shipment list, using the same
filtering as M:Clm.Konshub.WebService.Controllers.KonsHubShipmentQueryController.GetDashboardIncommingShipmentList(Queries.DashboardIncommingShipmentListQuery) plus an optional explicit
restriction to specific unloading zones/shipments.

Generates an Excel export of the filtered outgoing shipment list, using the same
filtering/sorting as M:Clm.Konshub.WebService.Controllers.KonsHubShipmentQueryController.GetDashboardOutgoingShipmentList(Queries.DashboardOutgoingShipmentListQuery) plus an optional
explicit restriction to specific unloading zones/shipments.

Looks up the current numeric value of a named sequence counter (used elsewhere, e.g.,
to determine how many split/mass-delivery shipments exist for a parent shipment via the
conventional key `konshub-shipment-{ShipmentId}`).

Builds the data needed to populate the shipment dashboard's filter panel: sender/recipient
team options for the site, unloading equipment options for the site's warehouse, and the
current user's previously saved dashboard filter presets.

Computes incoming shipment counts "by UP" (unloading point/zone): for zones with an
active calendar reservation covering the date range, the daily count of shipments in
open/approved statuses assigned to each zone, plus calendar-derived availability, and a
combined total (permission-aware based on the caller's team membership).

Given a parent incoming shipment, returns its related child shipments — either regular
split children (same `ShipmentId`, `ParentShipmentId` set) or mass-delivery
children — ordered by shipment number and labeled with the split-shipment sequence count.

Returns a paged, filtered, sorted list of incoming shipments for the dashboard,
restricted to the site's unloading zones. Each row includes its split-shipment count.

Computes outgoing shipment counts "by UP" (unloading point/zone): for zones with an
active calendar reservation covering the date range, the daily count of Incoming/Planned
shipments assigned to each zone, plus calendar-derived availability, and a combined total.

Given a parent outgoing shipment, returns its related sibling shipments — mass-delivery
children or split children sharing the same `ShipmentId` — ordered by shipment
number and labeled with the split-shipment sequence count.

Returns a paged, filtered list of outgoing shipments for the dashboard, sorted by
scheduled/set/ship date. Each row includes its split-shipment count.

Excel-export variant of M:Clm.Konshub.WebService.Controllers.KonsHubShipmentQueryController.GetDashBoardShipmentsForNextSevenDays(Queries.DashBoardShipmentsForNextSevenDaysQuery): fetches the
same next-7-workdays (or single-date) shipment set and generates a workbook with
localized headers.

Returns shipments scheduled within the next 7 working days (Mon-Fri, weekends skipped)
for a site, or for a single selected day if `SelectedDate` is given instead of the
rolling window.

Computes shipment counts for each tab of the Deliveries screen (Incoming, Unplanned,
Planned, Commissioned, Completed) plus a grand total, scoped to shipments the current
user is permitted to see (role/team-assignment based visibility).

Returns the paged, sorted list of shipments for one specific tab of the Deliveries
screen, applying the same permission-scoped base filters as
M:Clm.Konshub.WebService.Controllers.KonsHubShipmentQueryController.GetDeliveriesTabShipmentCount(Queries.GetDeliveriesTabShipmentCountQuery) plus the tab's specific status/date predicate
(e.g. Commissioned requires a commissioned status and not completed; Planned requires
`Status == Planned` and excludes commissioned/cancelled shipments).

Validates (sanity-checks `SelectedDate`) then aggregates shipment unit counts by
building for the dashboard's donut/pie chart, over the same date window used by
M:Clm.Konshub.WebService.Controllers.KonsHubShipmentQueryController.GetDashBoardShipmentsForNextSevenDays(Queries.DashBoardShipmentsForNextSevenDaysQuery) (single selected date or next 7 working days).

Retrieves the audit/event-log history for a KonsHub shipment (the controller forces
`EntityName` to `KonsHubShipment` regardless of client input), enriched with
the name of the user who created each log entry.

Validates the target shipment (must exist, be `Unplanned`, and not already be a
mass-delivery shipment) then computes mass-delivery scheduling numbers for it: total
original units across the parent and its mass-delivery children, delivered vs. planned
units, remaining units, and the next available split-sequence label (A, B, ... Z, AA...).

Fetches a shipment's material handover record (validated up front — fails if no matching
handover record exists for the shipment/type). Resolves up to 3 material photo URLs for
handover events in the Paused/Completed state.
Fetches all comments on a shipment, each enriched with the creator's profile info.

Builds the list of people responsible for a site by combining CLM team members
(vendor/SM/SP/PM teams tied to the site or its project) with manually added
site-level responsible-person records.

Returns the KonsHub-enabled sites the current user may access, for a site-picker UI.
Admins get all active sites with a configured warehouse; other users only get sites tied
to their team assignments.

Reads previously stored weather forecast/history records for a site over a date range
(no live external API call — data is pre-ingested into the `MeteomaticsInfo` collection).

Free-text search over a site's deliveries spanning EVERY tab in a single call —
built for clients (the mobile app) that only know a shipment number or team name and
not which tab the shipment currently sits in. Applies the same permission-scoped base
filters as M:Clm.Konshub.WebService.Controllers.KonsHubShipmentQueryController.GetDeliveriesTabShipmentList(Queries.GetDeliveriesTabShipmentListQuery) but no tab predicate; instead
each result row carries the tab it resolves to, so the caller can go straight to that
tab afterwards rather than probing all five.

Looks up vendor teams (`TeamType.Vendor_Team`) assigned to a site. Only valid,
non-deleted teams are returned, and "requested" (not yet accepted) teams are excluded
unless explicitly requested. Results are sorted alphabetically by name.

Removes a previously saved list-view filter preset from the current user's settings by
`FilterId`. A no-op (no error) if the user has no saved filters.

Queues an asynchronous export of the filtered shipment list-view to Excel. The queue
consumer re-runs the same shipment filtering used by the list-view grid, adds computed
split-shipment counts and translated unit names, generates the workbook, and pushes a
real-time notification (tagged `ListViewExcelReportGenerated`) carrying the
resulting `FileId` once the file is ready for download.

Creates or updates a named, reusable list-view filter preset on the current user's
settings document (per-user, not global/shared). If the user has no settings yet, one
is bootstrapped first; the filter is matched by `FilterId` and either appended or
updated in place.

Builds the data needed to populate the list-view's filter UI for a site: the current
user's previously saved filter presets, the site's eligible sender/recipient teams
(filtered by the requested team types), and the site warehouse's available unloading
equipment (including a "self-unloading" pseudo-equipment option read from platform config).

Returns shipment counts for the list-view's Open/Approved/Completed tabs for a site.
If the caller is a vendor-role team member (not an admin), results are further scoped
to shipments sent by that member's own team(s).

Returns a sorted, paged page of shipments for the list-view grid, applying the same
permission-scoped filters as M:Clm.Konshub.WebService.Controllers.ListView.ListViewQueryController.GetShipmentsCountForListView(Queries.GetShipmentCountForListViewQuery) plus status
filtering, sorting, and paging. Each row includes a computed split-shipment count.

Discards a shipment being worked on in the wizard. If it's still an unsaved draft
(tagged `IsValidDraftedKonsHubShipment`), the shipment document is deleted outright.
If it's an already-created shipment with an in-progress edit, only the staged
`DraftedShipment` changes are cleared — the underlying shipment is preserved.

Step 1 of the wizard. Creates a new drafted shipment if `KonsHubShipmentId` doesn't
exist yet (tagged `IsValidDraftedKonsHubShipment`, `ApprovalStatus = UnApproved`);
otherwise sets the booking date/weather directly on the shipment (create flow) or stages
it into `DraftedShipment.BookingDate` (edit flow).

Step 2 of the wizard. Sets material/building/location details either directly on the
live shipment (create flow) or staged into `DraftedShipment.Material` (edit flow).

Final step 5 of the wizard — finalizes the shipment. Create flow: attempts to create the
calendar reservation for the chosen zone/time window (fails with
`RESERVATION_SLOT_UNAVAILABLE` if unavailable, or `ERROR_STEP_4_NOT_SAVED` if
step 4 wasn't completed), retags the shipment `IsValidKonsHubShipment`, generates
its shipment number, computes express/sustainability info, saves, and queues a background
shipment-create event. Edit flow: merges the `OtherInfo` draft plus all other staged
`DraftedShipment` sections onto the live shipment, clears the draft, saves, and
queues a background shipment-update event (carrying old/new state for diffing).

Step 4 of the wizard. Sets the chosen unloading zone, scheduled time window, slots, and
equipment directly on the shipment (create flow) or stages them into
`DraftedShipment.Timeslots` and cascades the booking date into other already-staged
draft sections for date consistency (edit flow). Note: the actual calendar reservation is
only created later, in M:Clm.Konshub.WebService.Controllers.ShipmentWizard.ShipmentWizardCommandController.SaveShipmentWizardOtherInfo(Commands.ShipmentWizardOtherInfoCommand).

Step 3 of the wizard. Builds a `Vehicle` entity from the selected unloading vehicle
and sets it directly on the shipment (create flow) or stages it into
`DraftedShipment.UnloadingEquipment` (edit flow).

Replaces the shipment's "on-site responsible person" entry, syncs the new person onto
the site/team as an additional responsible person via a background command, and — if the
shipment date is today or later — clears cached PDFs and re-queues PDF+email regeneration
so the shipment document reflects the new contact.

Changes a shipment's approval/lifecycle status: `Approve` (bulk-approves all
sibling shipments sharing the same `ShipmentId`, queues PDF+email, logs the event),
`Reject` (marks completed with a discard comment, cancels commissioning, deletes the
calendar reservation, queues PDF+email), or `Cancel` (marks Withdrawn/Canceled
depending on prior state, same discard side effects as reject). Role-based authorization
applies per target status (e.g. rejecting an unapproved shipment requires a comment;
cancelling one requires the caller belong to the sender-team vendor role).

Computes recommended delivery time-slot windows around a chosen unloading zone/date, for
the timeslot picker's suggestions. Considers the nearest available weekday before, the
selected day (if valid for the zone), and the nearest available weekday after; for each,
slides a window of consecutive slots sized to `BookingDuration` that doesn't overlap
any of the shipment's own existing bookings in that zone.

Step 1 data: bookable calendar dates for a warehouse/month. A date is bookable if it has
at least one `KonsHubBookingPrerequisite` zone entry, isn't in the past, and falls
within the site's active date range.

Step 2 data: everything needed for the material picker, gathered in parallel — the
sending team's materials (flagged with the current user's per-site favourites), eligible
teams for the site, the site's building/floor structure, and the global material-unit dictionary.

Resolves the nearest bookable date when the user navigates to the next/previous/current
available booking date. Looks at booking prerequisites within a ±10-day window around
`BookingDate` and finds the nearest matching date, also flagging whether a further
next/previous date exists.

Step 4 data: available unloading zones and equipment for a warehouse/date. Finds the
zones referenced by that day's booking prerequisites, computes each zone's slot length
from its live calendar reservation, and lists active unloading equipment (plus a
"self-unloading" option if configured).

Step 3 data: unloading vehicle options. Only returns data if the warehouse/date has a
booking prerequisite. Loads a fixed vehicle catalogue, the site's uploaded warehouse
reference files, and an optional "self vehicle" option (appended last, if configured).

Groups a set of stored shipments onto a single commission transport vehicle. Builds a
new pending `KonsHubCommission` summing pitches across the shipments and
auto-generating a comment listing each shipment/unit.

Bulk-creates one or more new storage zones, auto-generating lettered rows (A, B, C…)
and numbered pitches (1, 2, 3…) to match each zone's requested dimensions.

Validates and queues an asynchronous export of the site's storage occupancy for a given
day to Excel. The queue consumer computes zone/row/pitch-level occupancy (count and
transport-unit totals) for shipments occupying storage on that date, generates the
workbook, and pushes an in-app notification to the requesting user once it's ready.

Creates a new commission transport vehicle (if `ItemId` doesn't match an existing
one) or updates an existing one's name, pitch capacity, icon, and id-name.

Records/updates the storage zone/row/pitch for a single incoming shipment. Recomputes
the shipment's `StorageLocation` label, logs a storage event, and — if the shipment
date is today or later — clears cached PDFs and queues PDF regeneration with email.

Applies the same storage zone/row/pitch to a batch of shipments at once (bulk variant of
M:Clm.Konshub.WebService.Controllers.StorageCommission.StorageCommissionCommandController.SaveStorageInformation(Commands.SaveStorageInformationCommand)). Each shipment's `StorageLocation` label is
recomputed and a storage event is logged; shipments dated today or later also get their
cached PDFs cleared and regeneration queued.

Records/updates where a single incoming shipment is physically stored: zone, row,
pitch, arrived/stored unit counts, and stacking info. Recomputes the shipment's
`StorageLocation` label, logs a storage event, and — if the shipment date is today
or later — clears cached PDFs and queues PDF regeneration with an email notification.

Replaces the full set of storage zones for a site/warehouse in one call: zones present
in both the submission and the database are updated, new ones (no matching existing ID)
are created, and existing zones missing from the submission are deleted. Renamed zones
have their new name propagated asynchronously onto related shipments' storage-location labels.

Updates a single storage zone's name, capacity, and row/pitch counts (rows/pitches are
regenerated as lettered/numbered lists to match the new counts). Any rename is
propagated asynchronously to the `StorageLocation` label on every shipment stored
in that zone.

Checks whether another commission transport in the same warehouse/site already uses the
given `IdName` or `Name`, used for uniqueness validation before create/save.
Throws if `PropertyValue` is blank or `PropertyName` is anything other than
`"id"`/`"name"`.

Computes daily storage occupancy for the dashboard's occupancy chart: per storage zone
and per weekday in the date range, the number of transport units and pitches used by
incoming, outgoing, and currently-occupied shipments, plus their percentage of each
zone's pitch capacity (`NumberOfRows * NumberOfPitches`), and a site-wide combined total.
Lists all commission transport vehicles (used to move commissioned shipments) for a site.

Returns a paged, filtered list of shipments arriving into storage: shipments with
storage information set, whose `ShipmentDate` falls in the filter window and whose
storage zone is one of the site's (or given) storage zones.

Returns a paged, filtered list of shipments physically occupying storage at some point
during the filter window (`ShipmentDate` before the window end and, if scheduled,
`ScheduledDate` after the window start), restricted to the site's (or given) storage zones.

Returns a paged, filtered list of shipments leaving storage: shipments with a
non-null `ScheduledDate` falling in the filter window, restricted to the site's
(or given) storage zones.

Looks up storage zones (name, capacity, rows/pitches, warehouse/site/org info) matching
an optional combination of filters.

get.summary:
Diagnostic endpoint that dumps the super-admin and service ("Blocks") account identifiers
and credentials the application currently has configured, reading each value from both
app configuration (appsettings/secret store) and the raw environment variable so
misconfigurations between the two sources can be spotted.

post.summary:
Synchronously invokes an arbitrary data-processing/maintenance routine by name.
The handler reflectively looks up a method named `ProcessName` on
`IDataProcessingService` and invokes it with the command as the argument,
so this endpoint acts as a generic dispatcher for one-off admin data jobs
(e.g. backfills, batch fixes) rather than a single fixed operation.

Fire-and-forget variant of M:Clm.Shipment.WebService.Controllers.TestController.ProcessKonsHubData(Commands.DataProcessorCommand): instead of running the named
data-processing routine inline, it enqueues the same Commands.DataProcessorCommand onto
the background queue so it is picked up and executed asynchronously by the queue consumer.

Creates a new `KonsHubZone` or updates an existing one (by `ItemId`),
including its geometry, calendar reservation, and ordered direction waypoints (waypoints
are fully replaced on update). Renaming a zone triggers regeneration of any shipment
PDFs that reference the old name, and any zone change queues a background recomputation
of the parent warehouse's booking prerequisites.

Bulk-updates the `LocationAddress` of one or more warehouse zones. When an updated
zone is an entry point, the new address is also cascaded to every unloading zone that
references that entry point, keeping the denormalized address copies in sync.

Checks whether another zone in the same warehouse already uses the given `IdName`
or `Name`, used for uniqueness validation before create/save. Throws if
`PropertyValue` is blank or `PropertyName` is anything other than
`"id"`/`"name"`.

Fetches a single warehouse zone by ID, enriched with its ordered direction waypoints
(each waypoint's latitude/longitude parsed out of the stored "lat,lng" location string).
Soft-deleted zones are excluded.
Lists all zones (entry points, unloading zones, etc.) belonging to a warehouse.
